name: where_order_paging
comment: The kitchen sink: top-level where entries AND implicitly; parameters number @c0.. in render order — WHERE first, then limit, then offset; property names resolve to columns through the metadata.

sqlite.sql: select id, name, email, display_name, created_at, updated_at from users where ((id = @c0 or name in (@c1, @c2)) and created_at >= @c3) order by name desc, id limit @c4 offset @c5
